key_insight: Change2Task turns real merged pull requests from repository history into executable coding-agent tasks on modern, healthy versions of the same codebase. This creates a scalable source of realistic, verifiable tasks for training, benchmarking, and continuous evaluation.
problem_solved: Coding agents need lots of high-quality executable tasks, but these are hard to create because each task must include a realistic software state, a clear specification, tools, and reliable verification. The paper addresses the shortage of such data by mining repository history and converting past changes into usable tasks.
method: Uses merged pull requests as historical evidence for task creation.
Aligns the old change with a newer healthy repository revision to reconstruct a valid coding environment.
Builds executable tasks with specifications, development tools, and verification so tasks can be tested automatically.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides a practical way to scale agent evaluation and training with realistic software engineering tasks. It can improve benchmark quality and support ongoing assessment of coding agents in environments closer to real-world development.

paper_title: Change2Task: From Repository Changes to Executable Coding Agent Tasks and Environments
paper_authors: Haomin Qi, Xingliang Wang, Xuanqi Gao, Baihui Sang, Xin Zhang
